functionalArchitectureSummary.ovenCavity: Built-in electric wall oven — bake, broil, true convection element and fan; no cooktop/surface heating
functionalArchitectureSummary.control: Copernicus Application Manager (ACU) per oven cavity; HMI-Central UI board; diagnostics mode with component activation
functionalArchitectureSummary.doubleOven: Independent upper/lower Copernicus ACU, per-cavity temperature sensors (F3 E0 main/upper vs E1 bottom/lower), per-cavity door latch (F5 E0/E1 vs E3/E4)
functionalArchitectureSummary.sensing: Cavity RTD ~1000–1200 Ω at 77°F; door/latch PTC ~500–3000 Ω
functionalArchitectureSummary.cooling: Dedicated cavity cooling fan high/low (F8E0/F8E1) — distinct from convection fan in component activation list
functionalArchitectureSummary.surfaceHeatingAbsent: No infinite-switch, cooktop relay, or surface zone vocabulary — surface_heating_system not instantiated
